LanguageData.LP_Feat_Alert.label: alert
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Alert.description: Always on guard against danger. Never caught off guard by ambushes (ambushes are dodged as usual, and you are not stunned by attacks that stun on hit); aiming time is always ×0.8; within 10 seconds of being drafted, weapon warmup time is halved again. Grants +1 Dexterity or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Tough.label: tough
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Tough.description: Tougher than they look. Part health +2% × adventurer level (+40% at level 20, counting up to level 30); the first 3 times downed each day, bleeding wounds stop, 20 points of injury heal at once, and pain is halved for 1 hour. Grants +1 Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Lucky.label: lucky
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Lucky.description: Fate always favors this person. Uses per day = proficiency bonus (2-8): when hit, make that attack re-roll its hit, or when you miss, re-roll once (melee and ranged); a failed save can also be retried once. Grants +1 to any ability score (added to your current highest).
LanguageData.LP_Feat_GreatWeaponMaster.label: great weapon master
LanguageData.LP_Feat_GreatWeaponMaster.description: A master of swinging heavy weapons. Two-handed melee weapons (mass over 2.5 kg) deal ×1.25 damage; after downing or killing an enemy with one, immediately attack the next adjacent enemy (cooldown 2 seconds). Grants +1 Strength.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Sharpshooter.label: sharpshooter
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Sharpshooter.description: A crack shot. Ranged weapon range +40%, ignores the target's cover entirely, ranged weapon damage ×1.15. Grants +1 Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Sentinel.label: sentinel
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Sentinel.description: Nobody slips past you. Melee hit chance ×1.1; when an enemy in melee range leaves, make a free attack against it at once (at most once per 0.5 seconds); on a hit the target is rooted for 1.5 seconds, then move speed halved for 2 seconds. Does not trigger on people with the "Mobile" feat. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_WarCaster.label: war caster
LanguageData.LP_Feat_WarCaster.description: Keeps spells steady amid flashing blades. Getting hurt during spell warmup does not interrupt it (no cast interruption, no damage stun); ability warmup time ×0.75; max neural heat +30. Works for class spells, VPE abilities and divine magic. Requires a spellcasting class (wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, paladin or arcane trickster) or a worn holy symbol. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Healer.label: healer
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Healer.description: Formally trained in battlefield medicine. Tend quality ×1.3, medical speed ×1.3, surgery success ×1.2; each tending also heals the 3 smallest wounds on the patient by 6 points each. Grants +1 Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_HeavyArmorMaster.label: heavy armor master
LanguageData.LP_Feat_HeavyArmorMaster.description: Knows how to make heavy armor take every hit. While wearing heavy torso armor (60%+ sharp armor), each sharp or blunt hit taken is reduced by (3 + proficiency bonus), i.e. 5-11 points (before armor). Grants +1 Strength or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Mobile.label: mobile
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Mobile.description: Nimble, moving in and out with ease. Move speed +0.4 then ×1.1; melee dodge +10; leaving melee does not provoke "Sentinel" free attacks. Grants +1 Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_InspiringLeader.label: inspiring leader
LanguageData.LP_Feat_InspiringLeader.description: A few words can get companions back on their feet. Gains the active ability "Inspire" (2 per day): allies within 10 cells get an "Inspired" shield for 1 day absorbing 20 + 3 × level + 5 × Charisma modifier damage, and mood +5 (half a day). Requires Charisma 13. Grants +1 Charisma or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_SpellSniper.label: spell sniper
LanguageData.LP_Feat_SpellSniper.description: Casts spells farther. Class spells (except touch spells and those using weapon range), VPE psycasts and divine magic get +75% range; neural heat recovery ×1.25. Requires a spellcasting class (wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, paladin or arcane trickster) or a worn holy symbol. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
